title: Small molecule natural compound targets the NF-kappaB signaling and ameliorates the development of osteoarthritis.
authors: Xu, Zhu; Shen, Zhong-Hai; Wu, Bin; Gong, Sui-Liang; Chen, Bin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然小分子nepetin抑制NF-kB信号改善骨关节炎，仅含p65分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，方法简单且对象偏离。
abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a multifactorial and chronic disease describing the destruction of cartilage that can lead to defects in the elderly. There is currently no practical strategy that can reverse the OA process. Here, we describe nepetin, a small natural compound with extracellular matrix (ECM) and inflammation regulating functions. In this study, we investigated the therapeutic effects of nepetin on interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta)-induced inflammation in mice chondrocyte and OA model. In chondrocytes, treatment with nepetin inhibited the overexpression of pro-inflammatory cytokines and mediators induced by IL-1beta. Moreover, pretreatment or posttreatment with nepetin also reduced the ECM catabolism and enhanced the ECM anabolism. Mechanistically, nepetin suppressed NF-kappaB signaling pathway in IL-1beta stimulated chondrocyte. Meanwhile, our molecular docking studies indicated nepetin had a powerful binding capacity to p65. Furthermore, nepetin showed a protective and therapeutic effect on the mouse OA model. To sum up, this study indicated nepetin had a new potential therapeutic option in OA.
abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种多因素慢性疾病，描述软骨的破坏，可导致老年人缺陷。目前尚无实用策略能逆转OA进程。在此，我们描述了荆芥素（nepetin），一种具有细胞外基质（ECM）和炎症调节功能的小分子天然化合物。本研究探讨了荆芥素对白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）诱导的小鼠软骨细胞炎症及OA模型的治疗作用。在软骨细胞中，荆芥素处理抑制了IL-1β诱导的促炎细胞因子和介质的过度表达。此外，荆芥素的预处理或后处理也减少了ECM分解代谢并增强了ECM合成代谢。机制上，荆芥素抑制了IL-1β刺激的软骨细胞中的NF-κB信号通路。同时，我们的分子对接研究表明荆芥素对p65具有强大的结合能力。进一步地，荆芥素在小鼠OA模型中显示出保护性和治疗性效果。总之，本研究表明荆芥素在OA治疗中具有新的潜在治疗选择。
